title: ALHAMBRA Castles and Gardens tour with Malgorzata Janusz
text: ALHAMBRA Castles and Gardens tour – Upon arrival (our group of five) we were warmly and timely welcomed by our tour guide Malgorzata Janusz (gosiaguide@gmail.com +34 671 240 939 Polish) and with such friendly atmosphere we had a great start! Our tour through Alhambra Castles and Gardens was extremely good and flexible (appreciate this very much). Malgosia is such a warm personality and highly motivated guide, very knowledgeable, answering straight away to any of our questions not only regarding palaces but also the Andalusia region and for that she deserves a special thanks. We all truly enjoy
author: Pegasusxy
